regressions.decompiled: implementationOf is mapping of struct of 1 slot at storage 0 / migratorForPath is mapping of mapping of struct of 1 slot at storage 2 / return address(implementationOf[version_].field_0) / ... / mem[_29 + 36 len 28] = uint128(implementationOf[toVersion_].field_32)
regressions.old: implementationOf is mapping of address at storage 0 / migratorForPath is mapping of mapping of address at storage 2 / return implementationOf[version_] / migratorForPath[fromVersion_][toVersion_] = migrator_
regressions.source: MapleProxyFactory: mapping(uint256 => address) public implementationOf; mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => address)) public migratorForPath
regressions.issue: The selector merge of each abi.encodeWithSelector(..., implementationOf[v]) now prints its low-28-byte rewrite as a read of bits 32..160 of the storage value ('uint128(implementationOf[toVersion_].field_32)', 3 lines). That phantom field turns both address mappings into 'struct of 1 slot', so every read, write and getter becomes 'address(x.field_0)' and def storage misdescribes the layout.
regressions.rule: Drop a store that writes back bytes already in memory (the merge keeps the low 28 bytes of the word just stored) before typing storage; and derive a storage field only from accesses that read storage itself, never from a value re-derived from a memory copy of a storage word.

regressions.old: mem[mem[64] + 100] = arguments_.length / mem[mem[64] + 132 len ceil32(arguments_.length)] = arguments_[all], mem[... len ceil32(arguments_.length) - arguments_.length]
regressions.source: MapleProxyFactory.upgradeInstance -> _upgradeInstance: migrator_ call with abi.encodeWithSelector(IProxied.migrate.selector, migrator_, arguments_)
regressions.issue: The copy of arguments_ into the migrate call buffer, a copy line from calldata in round 1, is now a word-copy loop from the memory copy with an unresolved length. The memory copy (mem[ceil32(_1) + ceil32(_2) + 128] = arguments_.length, data = arguments_[all]) is no longer forwarded past the implementation() staticcall and the setImplementation call, whose buffers sit at a free pointer joined from 'if return_data.size'. createInstance's identical copy is still a copy line.
regressions.rule: Keep a symbolic lower bound of the free pointer through joins (the max of the arms' bounds, each >= the value before the branch), so stores at mem[64] + k after the join cannot reach memory allocated before it; the forwarded copy then stays a copy line.

improvements: upgradeInstance's setImplementation copy loop and call now have constant sizes ('while idx < 36', 'args mem[_29 + 68 len 36]') and their return-data handling resolved addresses. Otherwise the text changed only in the two regressions above.
notes: Diff of 208 lines read in full. 'static call caller.mem[... + 196 len 4]' (the implementation() call printed with a memory slice as its name) is in the old text too, so it is not a change, but it is the same defect counted as a regression in c00007 and c00168. P4 count 4 -> 5 per the new pack header.
summary: Two medium regressions. A phantom storage field from the selector-merge store retypes both address mappings as structs ('address(implementationOf[v].field_0)' everywhere), and upgradeInstance's arguments_ copy line became a memory copy loop because forwarding is lost after a joined free pointer. Little improved.
